title: Check: Crude Oil and Fractional Distillation

questions.stem: In a fractionating column, where do the hydrocarbons with the shortest chains condense?

options.text: They do not condense and exit as gases at the top
At the top of the column where it is coolest
In the middle of the column
At the bottom of the column where it is hottest

questions.explanation: Short-chain hydrocarbons have low boiling points, so they rise as vapour through the column and condense near the top where it is coolest. The smallest molecules (C1-C4 refinery gases) may not condense at all and are collected as gases from the very top.
